rationale: SME direction: prose policy can initiate only a governed rule proposal with examples, conflict check, shadow evaluation, approval, capability-scoped apply, and replay.

examples.description: LLM proposes error_decomposer_machine but provides no comparison against existing error machines.
Proposal includes overlap analysis showing no current machine decomposes nested runtime errors.
Existing machine partially overlaps but adding new machine may reduce responsibility ambiguity.

proposed_rule.description: New machine proposals require evidence that existing machines cannot already satisfy the responsibility.

decision.message: Machine creation requires overlap analysis and responsibility-boundary evidence.
